Test Objective: Power-on initialisation — controller reaches OFF state after reset deassertion
Method: RTL simulation: apply reset_n=0 for 20 cycles then deassert; check initial FSM state
Expected Result: tone_controller state = OFF (3'b000); sound_out = 0; tone_en = 0
Evidence Required: VCD waveform showing reset release and immediate OFF state

Test Objective: Initial OFF state — SOUND_OUT is low and remains low without any button press
Method: RTL simulation: hold reset_n=1; no button input; observe sound_out for 1000 clock cycles
Expected Result: sound_out = 0 continuously
Evidence Required: VCD showing sound_out = 0 for entire idle period

Test Objective: First button press — transitions from OFF to Tone 1 state
Method: RTL simulation: press button (btn_raw=0 for debounce_cycles+10 cycles then release); observe FSM transition
Expected Result: FSM reaches Tone 1 state; tone_sel = 001; tone_en = 1; sound_out oscillates at 500 Hz (1000 cycles half-period)
Evidence Required: VCD waveform; measured square wave period = 2000 cycles

Test Objective: Second button press — transitions from Tone 1 to Tone 2
Method: RTL simulation: release then press again; observe transition
Expected Result: FSM = Tone 2; tone_sel = 010; actual frequency 700.28 Hz (N=714 cycles half-period)
Evidence Required: VCD showing FSM state transition and 700 Hz square wave

Test Objective: Third button press — transitions from Tone 2 to Tone 3
Method: RTL simulation: release then press again
Expected Result: FSM = Tone 3; N=556 half-period; actual 899.28 Hz
Evidence Required: VCD showing 900 Hz square wave

Test Objective: Fourth button press — transitions from Tone 3 to Tone 4
Method: RTL simulation: release then press again
Expected Result: FSM = Tone 4; N=417 half-period; actual 1199.04 Hz
Evidence Required: VCD showing 1200 Hz square wave

Test Objective: Fifth press returns to OFF state
Method: RTL simulation: release then press again from Tone 4
Expected Result: FSM = OFF; tone_en = 0; sound_out = 0
Evidence Required: VCD showing OFF state and silent output

Test Objective: Sixth press returns to Tone 1 — cycle repeats
Method: RTL simulation: press again from OFF
Expected Result: FSM = Tone 1; same as VER-D03
Evidence Required: VCD confirming cycle wraps correctly

Test Objective: Mechanical bounce — multiple short pulses do not advance state multiple times
Method: RTL simulation: apply 5 bounce pulses of < debounce_cycles duration followed by 1 stable press
Expected Result: Exactly one state transition per physically confirmed press; no extra transitions during bounce window
Evidence Required: VCD showing debounce counter resetting on bounce; single btn_event pulse at end

Test Objective: Long press — holding button down does not re-fire
Method: RTL simulation: hold btn_raw=0 for 100× debounce_cycles
Expected Result: Only one btn_event generated at the start; no repeated events while held
Evidence Required: VCD showing armed flag prevents re-triggering while held

Test Objective: Button press during power-up (before reset deassertion)
Method: RTL simulation: hold button pressed while reset_n=0 then deassert
Expected Result: System initialises to OFF regardless; no spurious transition
Evidence Required: VCD showing stable OFF after reset even with button active

Test Objective: Output disabled in OFF state — sound_out is exactly 0
Method: RTL simulation: confirm sound_out after 5th press
Expected Result: sound_out = 1'b0 throughout OFF state
Evidence Required: VCD showing clean low output in OFF

Test Objective: Output frequency measurement — Tone 1 (500 Hz)
Method: RTL simulation: measure period of sound_out in Tone 1
Expected Result: Period = 2000 clock cycles (2000 ns at 1 MHz). Half-period = 1000 cycles
Required Tool: Icarus Verilog + Python period measurement script
Evidence Required: Measured period matches N=1000 to within 1 cycle

Test Objective: Output frequency measurement — Tone 2 (700 Hz)
Method: RTL simulation: measure period in Tone 2
Expected Result: Period = 1428 cycles (N=714). Actual freq = 700.28 Hz
Evidence Required: Measured period = 1428 cycles

Test Objective: Output frequency measurement — Tone 3 (900 Hz)
Method: RTL simulation: measure period in Tone 3
Expected Result: Period = 1112 cycles (N=556). Actual freq = 899.28 Hz
Evidence Required: Measured period = 1112 cycles

Test Objective: Output frequency measurement — Tone 4 (1200 Hz)
Method: RTL simulation: measure period in Tone 4
Expected Result: Period = 834 cycles (N=417). Actual freq = 1199.04 Hz
Evidence Required: Measured period = 834 cycles

Test Objective: Duty cycle — 50% for all tones
Method: RTL simulation: measure high-time vs period for each tone
Expected Result: High-time = Low-time = N cycles; duty cycle = 50.0%
Evidence Required: Measured duty cycle 50.0% ± 1 cycle for all 4 tones

Test Objective: Reset recovery — assert reset during Tone 3 operation then deassert
Method: RTL simulation: assert reset_n=0 during playback then release
Expected Result: Controller returns to OFF state; sound_out = 0; no residual tone
Evidence Required: VCD showing clean OFF state after reset cycle

Test Objective: Synchroniser metastability — async button sampling
Method: RTL simulation with two-FF synchroniser: apply button transition near clock edge
Expected Result: No X-propagation to FSM; synchroniser absorbs transition in 2 clock cycles
Required Tool: Icarus Verilog with timing check or formal
Evidence Required: No X states observed in FSM state registers

Test Objective: Post-synthesis functional verification — netlist simulation with SCL cell models
Method: Re-run all VER-D01 to VER-D17 tests against gate-level netlist using c1d.v cell models; annotate SDF from STA
Expected Result: Same functional results as RTL simulation
Evidence Required: All test points pass with correct timing

Test Objective: Oscillator startup — circuit transitions from zero condition to sustained oscillation
Method: SPICE transient simulation: start from VDD ramp; observe output node
Expected Result: Oscillation begins within 100 µs of VDD reaching 4.5 V (TBD threshold)
Evidence Required: SPICE transient waveform showing startup and sustained oscillation

Test Objective: Oscillator nominal frequency — measure period at TT 27°C VDD=5V
Method: SPICE transient simulation at nominal corner
Expected Result: Frequency in range 800 kHz – 1.2 MHz (±20% of 1 MHz target)
Evidence Required: SPICE waveform with period measurement using .meas

Test Objective: Oscillator PVT corner — slow-slow process 0°C VDD=4.5V
Method: SPICE corner simulation (SS)
Expected Result: Oscillator must still start and sustain oscillation; frequency measured and recorded
Evidence Required: SPICE corner waveform with frequency measurement

Test Objective: Oscillator PVT corner — fast-fast process 85°C VDD=5.5V
Method: SPICE corner simulation (FF)
Expected Result: Oscillator must not over-drive; frequency measured and recorded
Evidence Required: SPICE corner waveform with frequency measurement

Test Objective: Oscillator supply variation — VDD = 4V to 5.5V sweep at TT 27°C
Method: SPICE DC sweep or multiple transient runs
Expected Result: Frequency variation across supply range measured; maximum drift documented
Evidence Required: Frequency vs VDD plot; acceptable range defined

Test Objective: Oscillator temperature variation — 0°C to 85°C at TT VDD=5V
Method: SPICE temperature sweep
Expected Result: Frequency variation across temperature range measured; TC coefficient extracted
Evidence Required: Frequency vs temperature plot

Test Objective: Oscillator startup time — time from VDD crossing 80% nominal to first full oscillation cycle
Method: SPICE transient: ramp VDD over 1 ms; measure time to stable oscillation
Expected Result: Startup time < 1 ms (TBD; must be less than POR pulse width)
Evidence Required: SPICE waveform with .meas startup_time

Test Objective: Oscillator current consumption — average current during steady-state operation
Method: SPICE transient: integrate supply current over multiple cycles
Expected Result: Current < target budget (TBD; goal < 1 mA from oscillator)
Evidence Required: SPICE waveform with .meas average current

Test Objective: Oscillator output waveform — rise/fall time and amplitude
Method: SPICE transient: measure output slew rate and swing
Expected Result: Rise/fall time < 50 ns (TBD); swing rail-to-rail or within digital input threshold
Evidence Required: SPICE waveform measurements

Test Objective: POR startup — reset_n held low during VDD ramp; deasserted after stable VDD
Method: SPICE transient with VDD ramp
Expected Result: reset_n = 0 during ramp; transitions to 1 after VDD reaches threshold + timeout
Evidence Required: SPICE waveform showing reset_n timing vs VDD

Test Objective: POR slow ramp — VDD ramps over 100 ms (slow power supply)
Method: SPICE transient with slow ramp
Expected Result: POR still generates valid reset pulse; controller does not enter unknown state
Evidence Required: SPICE waveform with slow ramp; reset_n pulse confirmed

Test Objective: POR brownout — VDD dips to 3V then recovers
Method: SPICE transient: model brief supply dip
Expected Result: Behaviour TBD — either holds reset or allows recovery without corruption
Evidence Required: SPICE waveform of brownout event; reset_n behaviour documented

Test Objective: Post-layout oscillator simulation — extracted parasitics applied
Method: SPICE simulation with extracted RC parasitics from oscillator layout
Expected Result: Frequency remains within ±5% of pre-layout result; startup still functional
Required Tool: Ngspice + SPICE netlist from PEX extraction (Magic or KLayout)
Evidence Required: Comparison of pre-layout and post-layout frequency

Test Objective: Design Rule Check — no DRC violations in routed layout
Method: KLayout DRC using drc.lydrc deck on post-routing GDS
Expected Result: Zero DRC violations or all waivers documented and approved
Evidence Required: DRC log file showing 0 violations; screenshots of clean DRC

Test Objective: Layout vs Schematic — LVS clean after routing
Method: KLayout LVS using lvs.lylvs with CDL netlist reference
Expected Result: LVS: 0 errors — topology and device sizes match between GDS and CDL reference
Evidence Required: LVS log showing pass; matched device count

Test Objective: Parasitic extraction — SPEF file generated
Method: OpenRCX using scl_c1d.rcx.lib after routing
Expected Result: SPEF file generated with R/C values for all nets
Evidence Required: SPEF file presence and non-zero RC values on critical nets

Test Objective: Post-layout STA — timing clean at all corners
Method: OpenSTA using extracted SPEF and Liberty corners (max/typ/min)
Expected Result: Setup slack ≥ 0 at all corners; hold slack ≥ 0; no timing violations in STA report
Evidence Required: STA timing report with setup/hold slack summary; no negative slack

Test Objective: Pad-ring DRC — pad-frame GDS verifies cleanly
Method: KLayout DRC on assembled pad-frame + core GDS
Expected Result: Zero pad-ring DRC violations
Evidence Required: DRC log for pad-frame assembly

Test Objective: Power analysis — IR drop within acceptable bounds
Method: OpenROAD power analysis after P&R
Expected Result: IR drop < 10% of VDD on power rails (TBD; depends on load current)
Evidence Required: Power grid IR drop map; worst-case drop value
